{{Top|leg}}
A '''class-zero launch engine''' was a type of propulsion system that was centuries old by the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[The Ark]] made use of a class-zero launch engine.
